title: NASA-JAXA XRISM mission sees a pulsar gathering a companion star's wind
summary: XRISM observations captured detailed evidence of a giant star's wind being captured by its neutron-star companion, helping scientists study the process behind strong X-ray flares.

title: NASA Hubble spots an out-of-sync galaxy
summary: NASA highlights a new Hubble observation of a galaxy whose motion and surroundings reveal a more complex environment than its appearance suggests.

title: NASA's Moon orbiter spots a new once-in-a-century crater
summary: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter data helped identify a newly formed lunar crater, giving scientists a rare opportunity to study a recent impact and its effects on the surrounding surface.

title: CERN begins disconnecting the LHC for the HiLumi upgrade
summary: CERN has begun disconnecting and dismantling focusing magnets around ATLAS and CMS as part of the third long shutdown and the move toward the High-Luminosity LHC.

title: NASA continues Crew-13 preparations as astronauts enter quarantine
summary: NASA reports that Crew-13 preparations continue as the astronauts enter quarantine ahead of their planned mission to the International Space Station.

title: NASA reports a new record-setting young planet
summary: NASA highlights a newly reported planet described as a remarkably young world, adding another data point to the study of how planetary systems form.
